entities.summary: Mateu Alemany Font is a Spanish executive and former president of Mallorca during two tenures. Between 2017 and November 2019 was the general director at Valencia. Between March 2021 and September 2023 he was a football director at FC Barcelona. Since October 2025 he is a football director at Atletico Madrid. Mateu Alemany Font was a legal figures from Andratx (b. 1963-07-28, Andratx). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
